# A transaction whose every split is on the account a payment block would call
# the bank — money moved within one account and nowhere else. There is no other
# side to retarget, which is a different mistake from naming a transaction
# whose other sides are all spoken for, and gets a different remedy.
2026-03-10 * "Bank correction, both sides in one account"
  Assets:Bank  25.00 CAD
    memo: "In"
  Assets:Bank  -25.00 CAD
    memo: "Out"
